title: agropyron repens subsp. dumetorum
intro: Agropyron repens subsp. dumetorum, commonly known as creeping bentgrass, is a type of plant that belongs to the grass family Poaceae. It is known for its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its various health benefits, including wound healing, reducing inflammation and pain, and fighting against infections. The therapeutic actions of creeping bentgrass include its ability to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
